tokens.name: surface-canvas
tokens.usage: The desk behind everything: the app background. Holds cards, never running text.

tokens.name: surface-panel
tokens.usage: Sidebar, drawers and other secondary regions that sit beside the stage.

tokens.name: surface-sheet
tokens.usage: The sheet of music: the score, the chord chart and the top bar. Reserved for notation and the frame around it.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards and controls at rest: meta strip, practice bar, buttons, inputs, tiles on a panel.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Anything that floats above the page: dialogs, popovers, menus.

tokens.name: surface-well
tokens.usage: Recessed fill inside a card or dialog: stat tiles, callouts, the segmented track.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed wash over any surface, for ghost buttons, list rows and icon buttons.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: The one inverted control, Stop. Flips with the theme; the keyboard case does not.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dimmer behind a dialog or an open drawer.

tokens.name: veil
tokens.usage: Paper-colored veil over the score while results show, so the notation stays visible underneath.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and engraved notation, on every surface. At least 11:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: status messages, descriptions, staff lines. At least 6:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: field labels, hints, units. At least 4.5:1 on surface-card, surface-sheet, surface-panel, surface-well and surface-overlay; never on surface-canvas in the light theme.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Dividers inside a card or panel. Decorative; never the only thing that marks a control.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Outline of cards and of buttons that carry a text label. Decorative.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Boundary of controls that need one to be found: inputs, the off switch, slider track, hover outline. At least 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px solid ring, 2px off the control. At least 5:1 on every surface. On the keyboard case use keyboard-accent instead.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Oxblood, the one brand color. Means "you are here" and "this is the next step": primary button, cursor, current note, selected state, level number. Text-safe on every surface.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of the primary button.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind selected items and accent badges. Pair with accent text; sits on surface-card, surface-sheet, surface-panel or surface-overlay.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill. Never literal white.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Right, in time, mastered. Text and fills. A blue-leaning green so it stays apart from danger for red-green color blindness.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind success text: the pass ribbon, "Perfect" grade, heard-your-piano note.

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a success fill.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Nearly: early, late, uneven, needs a look. Text-safe amber on card, sheet, panel and overlay.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind warning text: early and late grades, a calibration caution.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Wrong note, missed note, destructive action. Carmine, the correction pencil: a cool red kept apart from the warm oxblood accent. Always with a second cue (shape, motion or words).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind danger text: the wrong-note status, a failed check.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a danger fill.

tokens.name: reward
tokens.usage: Earned things, as a fill or mark: XP, streak, mastery star, tier progress, first-sight badge, count-in beat. Graphics only in the light theme (3:1); for words use reward-text.

tokens.name: reward-text
tokens.usage: Reward wording: "+120 XP", "First sight". Text-safe on card, sheet, panel and overlay.

tokens.name: reward-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind reward text in badges.

tokens.name: on-reward
tokens.usage: Text on a solid reward fill (the Mastered badge). Dark in both themes; white fails on gold.

tokens.name: score-staff
tokens.usage: Staff lines, bar lines and the brace. Quieter than the notes they carry.

tokens.name: score-label
tokens.usage: Note names, fingering and bar numbers around the staff.

tokens.name: score-cursor
tokens.usage: Fill of the Wait-mode cursor and of the current chord cell.

tokens.name: score-cursor-edge
tokens.usage: Outline of the cursor. At least 3:1 on surface-sheet so the place is findable without the fill.

tokens.name: score-good
tokens.usage: Notehead played right. A graphic tone: 3:1 on surface-sheet, brighter than success so it reads against black notes.

tokens.name: score-ok
tokens.usage: Notehead with the right pitch but off the beat.

tokens.name: score-bad
tokens.usage: Notehead played wrong or missed (missed also drops to opacity-missed).

tokens.name: keyboard-case-top
tokens.usage: Top of the piano case behind the on-screen keys. Dark in both themes: it is an instrument, not a panel.

tokens.name: keyboard-case-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom of the piano case; the case runs top to bottom between the two.

tokens.name: keyboard-text
tokens.usage: Text and active icons on the keyboard case.

tokens.name: keyboard-text-muted
tokens.usage: Resting icons, pedal label and range on the keyboard case. 4.5:1 on the case.

tokens.name: keyboard-accent
tokens.usage: "On" on the keyboard case: guide on, sound on, pedal down, focus ring.

tokens.name: keyboard-felt
tokens.usage: The felt strip above the keys. Same oxblood in both themes.

tokens.name: key-white
tokens.usage: White key. Dimmed a step in the dark theme to cut glare.

tokens.name: key-white-shade
tokens.usage: Shading at the top and bottom edge of a white key.

tokens.name: key-white-edge
tokens.usage: Line between white keys.

tokens.name: key-black
tokens.usage: Black key body.

tokens.name: key-black-top
tokens.usage: Lit top of a black key.

tokens.name: key-ink
tokens.usage: Note names and computer-key hints on a resting white key. 6:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: key-ink-strong
tokens.usage: Labels on a white key that carries a state tint.

tokens.name: key-ink-c
tokens.usage: The C labels (C3, C4, C5) that anchor the octaves.

tokens.name: key-black-ink
tokens.usage: Labels on a black key.

tokens.name: key-expected
tokens.usage: White key the guide asks for next. Paired with a dot above the label.

tokens.name: key-held
tokens.usage: White key held down right now, before it is judged.

tokens.name: key-correct
tokens.usage: White key held and right.

tokens.name: key-wrong
tokens.usage: White key pressed wrong. Paired with a shake and a cross.

tokens.name: key-black-expected
tokens.usage: Black key the guide asks for next.

tokens.name: key-black-held
tokens.usage: Black key held down.

tokens.name: key-black-correct
tokens.usage: Black key held and right.

tokens.name: key-black-wrong
tokens.usage: Black key pressed wrong.

tokens.name: heat-1
tokens.usage: Accuracy heatmap, lowest band (under 60%).

tokens.name: heat-2
tokens.usage: Accuracy heatmap, 60 to 74%.

tokens.name: heat-3
tokens.usage: Accuracy heatmap, 75 to 84%.

tokens.name: heat-4
tokens.usage: Accuracy heatmap, 85 to 94%.

tokens.name: heat-5
tokens.usage: Accuracy heatmap, highest band (95% and up). Five steps, not a hue sweep: the ends differ in hue on the blue-yellow axis and every band has a number beside it.

families.serif: Newsreader, "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Palatino, Georgia, serif

groups.name: Voice
groups.note: Newsreader. The voice of the music: names, numbers and verdicts. Never for controls or running UI text.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen at most: the play-from-memory title, large chord symbols on the chart. May scale fluidly from 1.75rem to 2.625rem with the stage width.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: The verdict on the results card.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Dialog titles.

styles.name: title-sm
styles.usage: Section titles in a panel, tier and item names, the wordmark.

styles.name: numeral-lg
styles.usage: The level number and the single figure a dialog is about. Always tabular lining figures.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Stat values on the stage and on the results card. Tabular so digits never shift.

styles.name: numeral-sm
styles.usage: Stat values in panel tiles and secondary results.

styles.name: chord
styles.usage: Chord symbols above the staff.

styles.name: bar-number
styles.usage: Bar numbers at the start of a system. The only italic in the app.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Figtree. Everything you operate or read as instruction. Shipped, so every platform measures the same.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Take your time. The cursor waits for you.
styles.usage: Text read from the piano bench: the practice-bar message, dialog lead paragraphs.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Weak and long-unplayed items come back first.
styles.usage: Default text: dialog copy, lists, results notes.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Show A S D F on the keys
styles.usage: Dense rows and hints in the sidebar, read leaning in.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: The smallest sentence text. Never on the stage.

styles.name: label-lg
styles.usage: Buttons on the stage, tapped from the piano bench: Start, Stop, Next.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Text inside controls: buttons, switch labels, tabs, list keys.

styles.name: label-sm
styles.usage: Segmented options, chips, badges, small buttons.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Field labels and stat keys, set in uppercase. One or two words.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Note names and fingering on the score and keys. May shrink with key width down to 0.5625rem, then hide.

styles.name: kbd
styles.usage: Keyboard shortcut caps inside buttons and help text.

groups.name: Site
groups.note: practice-piano.com only. The landing page sets everything in Newsreader at reading sizes.

styles.name: site-h1
styles.usage: Landing page headline; scales down to 2.625rem on phones.

styles.name: site-h2
styles.usage: Landing page section headings; scales down to 1.875rem.

styles.name: site-h3
styles.usage: Landing page feature headings.

styles.name: site-body
styles.sample: Plug in a MIDI piano and start reading.
styles.usage: Landing page body copy, in a 34em measure.

styles.name: site-hand
styles.usage: The teacher’s pencil notes over the hero score. Landing page only, never in the app.

spacing.note: A 4px grid with 2 and 6 for dense rows. The name is the pixel value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: between segmented options, label and value in a stat.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a chip; between rows of a dense list.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Label to control in a field; between badges.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between buttons; inside tiles and list rows; the default small gap.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between fields in a panel section; card padding on phones; between stage cards.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Card and popover padding; button side padding; stage padding.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Dialog padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Dialog padding; between panel sections.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Between groups on the results card and in dialogs with several parts.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Empty-state and splash breathing room.

radius.note: Nest by subtraction: a child’s radius is its parent’s minus the padding between them.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Keycaps, piano key bottoms, markers on keys.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Parts inside a control: the segmented thumb, note tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Controls and wells: buttons, inputs, tiles, callouts, list rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and popovers.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the results card.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills and dots: chips, badges, switch, progress, beat dots.

shadow.note: Borders carry structure; shadow only says "this floats". Three levels and a knob.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Cards resting on the canvas: meta strip, score, practice bar, keyboard.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus and the open drawer.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the results card.

tokens.name: shadow-knob
tokens.usage: The moving part of a control: switch knob, slider thumb, segmented thumb.

size.note: Control heights and fixed frame sizes.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, chips and icon buttons in dense panels.

tokens.name: size-control-md
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, inputs and the segmented control.

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: The tallest control: the practice bar's status row, which holds a two-line message, and a .btn-lg button. Stage buttons use size-control-md.

tokens.name: size-target-min
tokens.usage: Smallest touch area on a coarse pointer. Smaller controls reach it with an invisible hit area, never by changing size.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Icons inside controls.

tokens.name: size-icon-lg
tokens.usage: Icons that stand alone: dialog close, drawer toggle.

tokens.name: size-topbar
tokens.usage: Top bar height on tablets and desktop; two rows of this on phones.

tokens.name: size-sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar width at bp-lg and up; below it the sidebar is a drawer.

tokens.name: stroke-thin
tokens.usage: Borders and dividers.

tokens.name: stroke-thick
tokens.usage: Focus ring, the active tab underline, beat-dot rings, emphasized outlines.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: A disabled control and its label. Disabled things also drop their hover and pointer.

tokens.name: opacity-missed
tokens.usage: A missed note or chord, with score-bad.

zIndex.note: One scale for the whole app. Local stacking inside a component stays at 1 or 2.

tokens.name: z-raised
tokens.usage: Inside a component: black keys over white, a marker over its key.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: The results veil over the score; sticky headers.

tokens.name: z-drawer
tokens.usage: The sidebar drawer and its scrim.

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: Popovers and menus.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and their scrim.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Transient notices above everything.

duration.note: Feedback tied to sound is instant. Everything else is short.

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Key press, beat dot, pedal: anything that answers a note or a click of the metronome.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, color changes, popover fade.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Cursor moves, switch, drawer, dialog fade.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Progress bars filling, the wrong-note shake.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Everything that moves or appears.

tokens.name: ease-linear
tokens.usage: The Flow playhead and progress tied to musical time.

breakpoint.note: Reference values for the app shell; CSS custom properties cannot be used in media queries, so write the number. Components adapt with container queries instead.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Phones. Stats and shortcut caps drop out; dialogs go full screen below 600px.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Large phones and small tablets in portrait. Stage padding tightens; labels shorten.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Tablets in landscape. Below this the sidebar becomes a drawer.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Roomy desktop. Long lesson names and all meta items show.
